groups.label: Units with Allegiance: Thousand Sons have access to the Warlord traits in this supplement. One Thousand Sons unit in your army with the Character special rule may be selected as a warlord. A warlord may purchase a single Warlord Trait for free.
groups.printed: Units with Allegiance: Thousand Sons have access to the Warlord traits in this supplement. One Thousand Sons unit in your army with the Character special rule may be selected as a warlord. A warlord may purchase a single Warlord Trait for free.

choices.name: Lord of Flux
choices.text: All terrain within 18" of the Warlord is treated as Dangerous and Difficult Terrain by enemy units. This affects open terrain as well.

choices.name: Lord of Forbidden Lore
choices.text: Your Warlord knows all of the Psychic Powers from the Lore of Tzeentch in Codex Chaos Space Marines in addition to powers purchased from the Arcana Psychic Discipline Powers (see Armoury of the 15th).

choices.name: Undying Form
choices.text: A Warlord with this trait gains the Battle-Hardened and Feel no Pain (5+) special rules. In addition, they can re-roll 1 Invulnerable save per phase.

groups.label: All Thousand Sons units with the Psyker (x) special rule may purchase Psychic Powers from the following Discipline.
groups.printed: All Thousand Sons units with the Psyker (x) special rule may purchase Psychic Powers from the following Discipline.
groups.name: Arcana Psychic Discipline

choices.name: Divine Shot
choices.text: When this power is successfully cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain the Precision Hits special rule on all Shooting Weapons they are equipped with until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Hallucination
choices.text: When this power is successfully cast, select a single enemy unit within 12" of the Psyker. The target unit immediately Panics and performs a Fall Back Move. If the unit is still on the battlefield at the start of your next Shooting Phase, the target unit automatically rallies. The target of this Psychic Power cannot flee off the board and if their movement would take them off the board, they instead stop 1" away from the battlefield edge and rally.

choices.name: Levitation
choices.text: When this power is successfully cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain the Fly special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Tainted Battlefield
choices.text: When this power is successfully cast, all enemy units within 12" of the Psyker and any attached unit treat all terrain, including open terrain as Difficult Terrain and Dangerous Terrain.

choices.name: Telekinetic Throw
choices.text:
A unit with this Psychic Power is equipped with the following Psychic Weapon:

- Telekinetic Throw

choices.name: Temporal Manipulation
choices.text: When this power is successfully cast, all enemy units within 3" of the Psyker and any attached unit suffer -1 to their Initiative (I) characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Twist of Fate
choices.text: When this power is successfully cast, target 1 enemy unit within 18" of the Psyker. The target unit must re-roll all successful Save rolls (Armor, Cover, Invulnerable) until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

groups.printed: You may select 1 Scarab Occult unit in your army to become Sekhmet Terminators. The chosen unit gains +1 to their Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic.

groups.label: When this wargear is purchased, the model may immediately purchase 1 Psychic Power or Psychic Weapon from the Lore Tzeentch, Lore of Nurgle or Lore of Slaanesh.
groups.printed: When this wargear is purchased, the model may immediately purchase 1 Psychic Power or Psychic Weapon from the Lore Tzeentch, Lore of Nurgle or Lore of Slaanesh.

choices.name: Baleful Devolution
choices.text: When this power is cast, target 1 enemy unit within 18" of the Psyker. The target unit takes 2D6, Strength 4, AP4 Automatic Hits. If any models are slain in the target unit as a result of wounds inflicted by this Psychic Power, immediately summon a Chaos Spawn more than 3" away from the targeted enemy unit.

choices.name: Bolt of Change
choices.text:
A unit with this Psychic Power is equipped with the following Psychic Weapon:

- Bolt of Change

choices.name: Boon of Change
choices.text:
When this power is cast, the Psyker and their attached unit must pick to gain one of the following until the start of your next Shooting Phase:

- +1 to its Attack (A) characteristic.
- +1 to its Strength (S) characteristic.
- +1 to its Initiative (I) characteristic.

This power may be cast any number of times by a Psyker in the Shooting Phase if they can cast multiple times.

choices.name: Siphon Magic
choices.text: When this power is cast, select 1 enemy unit with the Psyker (x) special rule within 18" of the Psyker. The target unit may not cast any make any Psychic tests to cast Psychic Powers or Psychic Weapons until the start of your next Shooting Phase. In addition, if the target unit has any Psychic Powers or Psychic Weapons in effect, including Force, that effect is negated.

choices.name: Treason of Tzeentch
choices.text: When this Power is cast, select 1 enemy unit within 24" of the Psyker that is not an Automata or Drone Type. Immediately make a single Shooting Attack with the targeted unit as if it were your own. The unit is treated as your own for the purposes of determining friendly and enemy targets. The Shooting Attack by the controlled target unit are resolved as Snap Shots. The target unit is treated as an enemy unit immediately after its Shooting Attack is resolved.

choices.name: Blades of Putrefaction
choices.text: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain the Poison (4+) special rule on all Melee weapons they are equipped with until the start of your next Shooting Phase. If an effected model is equipped with a Melee type weapon with the Poison (x) special rule, it becomes Poison (2+) instead.

choices.name: Curse of the Leper
choices.text: When this power is cast, target 1 enemy unit within 18" of the Psyker. The target unit suffers -1 to its Strength (S) & Toughness (T) characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Fleshy Abundance
choices.text: When this power is cast, the Psyker or 1 friendly model within 24" Heals 1 lost Wound.

choices.name: Nurgle's Rot
choices.text: When this power is cast, target 1 enemy unit within 12" of the Psyker. The target unit takes 2D6, Strength 2, AP-, automatic hits.

choices.name: Plague Wind
choices.text:
A unit with this Psychic Power is equipped with the following Psychic Weapon:

- Plague Wind

choices.name: Delightful Agonies
choices.text: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain the Feel no Pain (5+) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Hysterical Frenzy
choices.text: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain the Arcing (6+) special rule on all melee weapons they are equipped with until the start of your next Shooting Phase. If the unit already has Arcing (x), improve Arcing (x) by 1 to a max of 3+.

choices.name: Sensory Overload
choices.text:
A unit with this Psychic Power is equipped with the following Psychic Weapon:

- Sensory Overload

choices.name: Sonic Shockwave
choices.text:
A unit with this Psychic Power is equipped with the following Psychic Weapon:

- Sonic Shockwave

choices.name: Symphony of Pain
choices.text: When this power is cast, target 1 enemy unit within 18" of the Psyker. The target unit suffers -1 to their Weapon Skill (WS) and Ballistic Skill (BS) characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.
